scripts.js:copy: mkdir -p dist/assets/js && cp -r src/assets/js/* dist/assets/js || true
scripts.build:sass: mkdir -p src/assets/scss && sass src/assets/scss:dist/assets/css --style=compressed || echo 'No SCSS to compile'
scripts.build:js: mkdir -p src/assets/js dist/assets/js && terser src/assets/js/*.js -o dist/assets/js/main.min.js || echo 'No JS to minify'
scripts.build:images: mkdir -p src/assets/img dist/assets/img && cp -r src/assets/img/* dist/assets/img || echo 'No images to copy'
